Maya (eng-runtime): Seeing sudden 95th/99th token-latency spikes on a small subset of long chats starting ~03:10 UTC. perf-bot fired an alert. Looks like eviction bursts could be the cause? Anyone else seeing this?
Samir (eng-runtime): Yep I see the same alert. Quick sample of traces shows KV evictions immediately before the latency jump. Graph: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/kv/evictions-by-time?s=2478123000&e=2478123600
Alex T: Can you paste the exact query you used to correlate them?
Samir (eng-runtime): Sure — used a quick PromQL join: ```sum by(node) (rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) / ignoring(node) group_left() sum by(node) (rate(request_tokens_total[1m]))``` — picks eviction bursts relative to token volume.
Dina (eng-runtime): Current telemetry only exposes kv_evictions_total with shard and node labels. We don't have an eviction_reason label (age/pressure/compaction), so it's hard to tell why pages are getting popped.
perf-bot: :warning: alert: high_kv_eviction_rate on pool=inference-prod-4 :warning:
Samir (eng-runtime): Also noticed sampling bias — residency sampler window is 5m so long-lived sessions with sparse touches look like low residency, then when they finally touch a cold page it triggers eviction churn.
Alex T: can you grab a short log snippet around a spike? would help see last_touch_seconds values.
Samir (eng-runtime): pasted from node-12 logs: `evict page id=0x7f3a age=1298s last_touch_secs=1297 reason=unknown shard=3` and `serve request id=r123 token_idx=458 kv_miss=true page_load_ms=148` — you can see immediate miss then token latency balloon.
Dina (eng-runtime): Proposed short-term fixes: 1) add eviction_reason label to kv_evictions_total 2) emit per-request `kv_latency_ms` metric 3) increase residency sampler window for long-chat experiments.
Alex T: For observability panels I'd add: - KV evictions (count) by eviction_reason - Per-session last_touch_age histogram - KV miss rate vs token-latency P99 overlay.
Maya (eng-runtime): Love it. Can someone file a tiny infra ticket and add dashboard tiles? Would like to triage after next deploy.
Dina (eng-runtime): I'll file INF-2341 and add the eviction_reason label + new panels. Assigning to me and Alex for the dashboard copy.
ops-bot: Scheduled runbook check: check-node-12 (owner: oncall) — please confirm if node needs cordon.
Samir (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation if we see repeats: enable temporary relaxed eviction thresholds on affected pool (config flag: `kv.eviction.threshold=0.65`) and roll back after baseline.
Maya (eng-runtime): OK, plan: Dina adds labels + panels (INF-2341), Alex helps wire panels, I will monitor next 12h. Thanks all :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread about KV cache evictions correlating with token-latency spikes; contains PromQL, log snippets, action items.
